descriptions: Feed Flow Rate, simulated volumetric flow unit. Volumetric flow rate of slurry entering the thickener/dewatering system, reflecting feed load; Provides real-time feed load observation; observation. Input includes 30-minute history (t-29 to t-0) of feed flow rate relative to the current target minute; Influences pressures p2 and p3, Drives phase transitions (pressurizing/discharging).

Mid Pressure, simulated pressure unit. Pressure measurement at the middle section of the thickener, indicating compaction and hydraulic state; Reflects internal process dynamics and compaction condition; observation. Input includes 30-minute mid pressure history to capture dynamics related to underflow concentration; Related to feed flow q_in, Correlated with bottom pressure p3, Interpreted with phase indicators for state estimation.

Bottom Pressure, simulated pressure unit. Pressure measurement at the bottom of the thickener, strongly related to underflow concentration via pressure-concentration mapping; Primary observable proxy for underflow concentration; observation. Input includes 30-minute bottom pressure history; current pressure is most directly linked to current concentration; Most directly related to underflow concentration, Influenced by feed flow q_in and mid pressure p2, Phase (pressurizing/discharging) affects the mapping to concentration.

Pressurizing Phase Indicator, binary. Binary indicator showing whether the system is currently in the pressurizing (compaction) phase of the cycle; Distinguishes operational phase that governs compression and pressure build-up; state. Input includes 30-minute history of pressurizing phase status to contextualize other variables; Part of one-hot phase encoding; mutually exclusive with phase_discharging, Indicates phase of pressure increase affecting p2 and p3, Transitions triggered by pressure/flow conditions.

Discharging Phase Indicator, binary. Binary indicator showing whether the system is currently in the discharging/dewatering phase; Distinguishes operational phase that governs discharging and dewatering actions; state. Input includes 30-minute history of discharging phase status to contextualize other variables; Part of one-hot phase encoding; mutually exclusive with phase_pressurizing, Affects how bottom pressure p3 relates to underflow concentration, May correlate with feed flow q_in and pressure trends.
